lede: The biggest thing happening this week is actually a pair of back-to-back proceedings on Tuesday, September 30: HARC holds a special meeting to review the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W. Pacific — three separate large-scale building clusters all up for preliminary review at once — and right alongside it, Town Council convenes a special appeal hearing on the lot subdivision that has to happen before any of that development can move forward. The county also opens a work session on a proposed Employee Housing Impact Fee, the town's 2027 General Fund budget gets its first real public sketch-out on Thursday, and the San Miguel River Cleanup is Saturday.

notable.stake: HARC reviews all three Carhenge building clusters — a major redevelopment decision.
